name: Tunnels
author: fahmikemal
description: Tailscale, NetBird and ZeroTier behind one bar icon: a tab per installed VPN, official or self-hosted servers. Unofficial; not affiliated with any VPN vendor.

barWidget.description: One tab per installed VPN: connect, sign in, switch between official and self-hosted servers, browse machines and networks, copy addresses. Hides itself when no VPN is installed.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: Scaled with the theme's spacing and capped to the screen.
